Capitol Positions Guide

Know Your Buffs. Time Your Plays.
[OWOW] Old World Order
Capitol Officer Buffs
Capitol positions give powerful temporary buffs — time them with VS Duel days for maximum impact!

1. How It Works

The Capitol building in your base lets players take turns holding officer positions. Each position grants powerful speed buffs while you hold office. Positions rotate automatically through a queue system — or stay with you if no one else is waiting!

Capitol building — all officer positions
  • Requires HQ Level 16+ to apply
  • Maximum 50 players per queue
  • You can only be in one queue at a time
  • 30-minute cooldown between applications
  • Term duration depends on the queue — if others are waiting, ~5–10 minutes; if the queue is empty, you keep the position until someone joins or you resign
  • Buffs activate automatically when your turn comes
  • You can resign after 30 minutes of holding a position — but if no one's in the queue, keep it!
Critical Rule
Speed buffs only take effect when STARTING a new operation!
Builds, research, or training already in progress will NOT be affected. Start your actions DURING your buff window!

3. How to Apply

Position application screen — showing buffs and queue
1
Open the Capitol building in the center of your base
2
Select the position you want (tap the officer slot)
3
Tap "Apply" to join the queue
4
Wait for your turn — the buff activates automatically when you reach the front
In-office view — showing active buffs, time in office, and Resign button (available after 30 min)
Pro Tip: Off-Peak Hours
Apply for positions during off-peak hours (early morning, late night)
If no one else is in the queue, you’ll hold the position indefinitely — giving you a much longer buff window than the usual 5–10 minutes!

4. Strategic Timing — When to Use Each Position

VS Day Best Position Key Buff Why
Tuesday (Base Expansion) Sec. of Development +50% Construction Speed Start all building upgrades during your buff window
Wednesday (Age of Science) Sec. of Science +50% Research Speed Start all research projects during your buff window
Friday (Total Mobilization) Sec. of Security +20% Training Speed Start troop training batches during your buff window
Saturday (Enemy Buster) Sec. of Strategy +20% Healing Speed Heal troops faster between attacks
Mon / Thu / Anytime Sec. of Interior +100% Production Collect resources — useful any day
Key Insight
Apply 1–2 hours BEFORE the VS day starts (before 6pm server reset)
When your turn comes, IMMEDIATELY start your biggest builds, research, or training. The buff only helps operations you START during your term!

5. Buff Stacking

All speed bonuses in Last War stack multiplicatively. Capitol position buffs multiply with your VIP bonus, alliance tech, research bonuses, and other sources.

Example: Construction Speed on Tuesday
VIP 13 (+60%) × Sec. of Development (+50%) × Alliance Tech (+45%) × Fast Builder Research (+40%)
= All bonuses multiply together for massive combined speed!
Vice President Bonus
The VP buff (+20% Construction, +20% Research, +10% Training) is ALWAYS active for the holder
The VP buff applies only to the player holding the VP position (not server-wide). Unlike secretary positions, the VP is appointed and does not rotate through a queue.
